Name: Luwen's Cute Heart Balloon Scarecrow
Author: Luwenl
Description:
About This Mod

This mod replaces the textures of the


[list]
[*]Retextures the [b]Scarecrow[/b]
[*]Retextures all [b]Rarecrows[/b]
[*]Retextures the [b]Deluxe Scarecrow[/b]
[*]Cute [b]heart-shaped balloon design[/b]
[*]Keeps the [b]original scarecrow range and function[/b]
[/list]Texture Format

This mod uses the [b]Alternative Textures framework[/b], so the textures are applied as alternative skins instead of replacing the original game assets.


Compatibility[list]
[*]Works with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]
[*]Requires [b]Alternative Textures[/b]
[/list]Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿[/b]
[*]Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley Mods[/b] folder.

﻿﻿-----------------------------------------[/list]             
           Credits

Artwork and retexture created by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Luwenl]Luwen[/url][/b].
